result.summary: A narrow residential street with a sidewalk separated from the roadway by a grass verge. While the low-traffic nature of the street is beneficial, the environment lacks marked crossings and features significant visual obstructions from dense vegetation.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction
hazards.description: Dense trees and shrubs along the property line block sightlines between pedestrians on the sidewalk and approaching vehicles.
hazards.location_in_image: Left side of the image along the sidewalk and property edge

hazards.name: Lack of Marked Crossing
hazards.description: There is no designated or marked area for pedestrians to cross the street at this intersection.

hazards.name: Degraded Pavement
hazards.description: The roadway surface shows signs of cracking and patching, which can affect vehicle handling and create tripping hazards.

interventions.title: Daylighting and Vegetation Management
interventions.description: Trim back overgrown vegetation near the intersection to improve visibility for all road users.

interventions.title: Marked Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install high-visibility marked crosswalks to clearly define pedestrian right-of-way.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install curb extensions to shorten crossing distances and further improve sightlines by moving pedestrians into the driver's field of vision.

result.summary: The image shows a residential intersection that lacks basic pedestrian infrastructure, including sidewalks, marked crosswalks, and curb ramps. High hedges at the corner create significant visual obstructions, and the roadway pavement is in poor condition with extensive cracking and patching.

hazards.name: Lack of Sidewalks
hazards.description: Pedestrians are forced to share the roadway with vehicles due to the absence of dedicated walkways.

hazards.name: Visual Obstructions
hazards.description: Tall hedges at the intersection corner block sightlines between approaching vehicles and pedestrians.

hazards.name: Degraded Pavement
hazards.description: Extensive cracking and uneven surfaces in the roadway create trip hazards and may affect vehicle handling.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Installation
interventions.description: Construct continuous paved sidewalks on both sides of the street to provide safe pedestrian separation.

interventions.title: Marked Crosswalks and Curb Ramps
interventions.description: Install high-visibility crosswalk markings and ADA-compliant curb ramps at the intersection.

interventions.title: Vegetation Management
interventions.description: Trim or remove tall hedges near the intersection to restore clear sight triangles for all road users.

result.summary: The image shows a residential intersection with significant pavement degradation and a complete lack of marked pedestrian infrastructure. While sidewalks are present on one side, there are no marked crosswalks or curb ramps to facilitate safe crossing at the intersection.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crossing
hazards.description: The intersection lacks marked crosswalks, providing no designated space for pedestrians to cross the roadway.

hazards.name: Degraded Pavement
hazards.description: Extensive patching and cracking on the road surface create uneven terrain and potential tripping hazards.

hazards.name: Lack of Curb Ramps
hazards.description: The absence of curb ramps at the intersection corners creates a barrier for people with mobility devices.
hazards.location_in_image: Corner of the sidewalk on the left

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental or ladder-style marked crosswalks to define pedestrian right-of-way and increase driver awareness.

interventions.title: ADA Curb Ramps
interventions.description: Install detectable warning surfaces and sloped ramps at the intersection corners to ensure accessibility.

interventions.title: Pavement Resurfacing
interventions.description: Repair and resurface the roadway to eliminate tripping hazards and improve overall street quality.

result.summary: The residential street features a sidewalk separated from the roadway by a grass buffer, providing basic pedestrian accommodation. However, safety is compromised by dense vegetation blocking sightlines and a lack of marked crossings or visible street lighting.

hazards.name: Visual obstruction from vegetation
hazards.description: Dense bushes and low tree branches block sightlines between pedestrians on the sidewalk and vehicles, particularly at the driveway entrance.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the image, along the sidewalk edge.

hazards.name: Lack of street lighting
hazards.description: No visible street lights, which reduces safety and visibility for pedestrians during nighttime hours.

interventions.title: Vegetation Trimming
interventions.description: Prune overgrown bushes and trees to maintain clear sight triangles at driveways and potential crossing points.

interventions.title: Pedestrian-Scale Lighting
interventions.description: Install street lighting to improve visibility and security for pedestrians after dark.
